description: agro run node matrix. `agro run --isolation microvm` requires msb `0.7.13` exactly (mifunedev/agro#1591), but the `microsandbox` catalog entry installs the msb release of the day from a fixed installer commit. The remote-sandbox msb adapter already pins the version with a `sed` rewrite of the installer. The remote-sandbox skill runs checks that print `RESULT` lines on a new VM. On this host, `agro auth status` returns HTTP 401, so a live console run needs the operator.

userStories.title: The microsandbox tool installs msb 0.7.13
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro tool install microsandbox` to install msb 0.7.13 so that the microVM mode of `agro run` works after one command.
acceptanceCriteria: The `microsandbox` entry in `.agro/cli/src/lib/tools/catalog.ts` downloads the msb installer at tag `v0.7.13`, checks the script against its `sha256`, and installs version `v0.7.13`.
The install command fails when `msb --version` does not report `0.7.13`.
`.agro/cli/src/__tests__/tool-catalog.test.ts` pins the URL, the `sha256`, and the version check.
`agro run -- pnpm typecheck` exits 0, and `agro run -- pnpm test` shows no new failure against `evidence/baseline.md`.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged eb5c1406, via agro run): typecheck 0; tool-catalog and remote-sandbox tests 192/192. worker: installer at tag v0.7.13 has the same sha256 as the old pin; sed pins VERSION=v0.7.13 after the hash check; msb --version must contain 0.7.13; real install into a temp prefix printed msb 0.7.13. Lesson: the upstream script always writes its symlink under $HOME/.local/bin.

userStories.title: The agro run matrix check
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one remote-sandbox check for the `agro run` modes so that a new node proves the modes with one command.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/checks/agro-run-matrix.sh` installs AGRO from `INSTALL_URL`, adds the user to the `kvm` group, installs the microsandbox tool, and creates a scratch git repository.

The check prints one `RESULT` line for each of 8 rows. `X01` checks the container exit code, `X02` service reachability, `X03` egress allow, and `X04` egress deny. `X05` checks the microVM user and exit code, `X06` the microVM boot time from `microvm.jsonl`, `X07` the refusals, and `X08` leftovers.
The check runs each microVM row through `sg kvm`, because the new group applies only to a new login.
The check ends with a `SUMMARY` line and deletes the scratch repository.
`.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/SKILL.md` holds one section that names the check, the rows, and the run command.
userStories.notes: executed (advisor, merged 8cc1d0ab): bash -n ok; shellcheck at warning level clean (info notes SC2317/SC1091 match existing checks); rows X01-X08 present; SKILL.md section present. worker: local dry run on this host printed X01-X08 PASS and SUMMARY fails=0 with cleanup. Not exercised locally: fresh install from INSTALL_URL and the msb fallback (US-003).

userStories.title: Live run on a new node
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the matrix run on a new agro-console node so that the modes have proof outside this host.
acceptanceCriteria: `external`: the operator runs `agro auth login` on this host, because `agro auth status` returns HTTP 401.
Before the run, the console preflight (`console_preflight`) passes, and the run creates no node when the preflight fails.
`bash .agro/skills/remote-sandbox/scripts/run.sh console checks/agro-run-matrix.sh` on a free-tier `n4` node prints a `RESULT` line for `X01` to `X08`.
`.agro/tasks/agro-run-node-matrix/evidence/manual-review.md` records the rows, and `agro node list` shows no node that the run created.
